sections.intro_en: Apple Silicon only (M1 or newer Mac, recent iPhone or iPad). Most of these build on [nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative): you point a Mac app at your own game files and it builds an app for the Mac, or an IPA you sideload onto an iPhone or iPad. Many also need the `prod.keys` dumped from your own console.
sections.intro_zh: 只支持 Apple Silicon（M1 及以后的 Mac、较新的 iPhone 或 iPad）。多数基于 [nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)：在 Mac 上用工具指向你自己的游戏文件，生成 Mac 应用，或者生成 IPA 侧载到 iPhone、iPad。很多还需要从你自己主机 dump 的 `prod.keys`。

sections.intro_en: Each game is its own project, and each one supports only the game versions in its README: a dump of a different update will not build. Steam Deck works where the project offers a Linux build.
sections.intro_zh: 每款游戏是一个独立项目，只支持 README 里写的游戏版本，其他更新版本的 dump 无法构建。项目有 Linux 版的，一般也能在 Steam Deck 上跑。

sections.intro_en: Phones and Android handhelds (AYN Odin and Thor, Retroid Pocket). A recent Snapdragon chip with an Adreno GPU is the usual requirement.
sections.intro_zh: 手机和 Android 掌机（AYN Odin、Thor，Retroid Pocket 等）。一般要求较新的骁龙芯片和 Adreno GPU。

sections.zh: 重编译器：自己移植一款游戏
sections.intro_en: General tools for developers who want to recompile a game that has no project yet.
sections.intro_zh: 通用工具，适合想给还没有人做的游戏做重编译的开发者。

sections.en: The other direction: games recompiled to run on a Switch
sections.zh: 反方向：重编译到 Switch 上运行的游戏
sections.intro_en: Not Switch games: Xbox 360, GameCube, Wii U and PC games recompiled to run on a Switch as homebrew. They need a console that can run homebrew, and your own copy of the original game.
sections.intro_zh: 这些不是 Switch 游戏，而是把 Xbox 360、GameCube、Wii U 和 PC 游戏重编译成 Switch 自制程序。需要能运行自制程序的主机，以及你自己的原版游戏。

projects.name: nxnative
projects.en: Turns your own NSP folder into an unsigned iPhone/iPad app or a Mac app: the game code is rewritten for ARM64 and drawn through Metal. Most Apple tools below build on it.
projects.zh: 把你自己的 NSP 文件夹变成未签名的 iPhone/iPad 应用或 Mac 应用：游戏代码改写为 ARM64，画面直接走 Metal。下面多数苹果工具都基于它。

projects.name: NX2Apple
projects.en: One-click Mac app that packs your own game into an iPhone or iPad app, no terminal. Has profiles for 147 games.
projects.zh: Mac 上的一键图形界面，把你自己的游戏打包成 iPhone/iPad 应用，不用命令行。已有 147 款游戏的配置。

projects.name: S2Arm
projects.en: One app for your whole library on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with an in-game gear menu and an editable on-screen gamepad. Bring your own games and keys.
projects.zh: 一个应用装下整个游戏库，支持 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac，带游戏内设置和可编辑的虚拟手柄。游戏和密钥自备。

projects.name: d2r-mobile
projects.game_zh: 暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生
projects.en: Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android with full touch controls at a steady 60 fps.
projects.zh: 把你自己的 Switch 版原生跑在 iPhone、iPad、Mac 和 Android 上，完整触控，稳定 60 帧。

projects.name: LumaNX 璃游
projects.en: Chinese and English Mac GUI for nxnative: builds your games to run on the Mac and exports iPhone/iPad IPAs.
projects.zh: nxnative 的中英文 Mac 图形界面：图形化构建游戏，可在 Mac 上运行，也能导出 iPhone/iPad 的 IPA。

projects.name: ns-game-apple-arm-port
projects.en: Agent skill that walks a coding agent through porting a Switch game to Apple Silicon (macOS, iPadOS, iOS) with Rust and Metal.
projects.zh: Agent 技能：让编码 Agent 用 Rust 和 Metal 把一款 Switch 游戏移植到 Apple Silicon（macOS、iPadOS、iOS）。

projects.name: NX Play
projects.en: Mac app to build, play, install and manage your nxnative games, on the Mac and on iPhone or iPad.
projects.zh: Mac 应用，用来构建、游玩、安装和管理 nxnative 游戏，支持 Mac 和 iPhone/iPad。

projects.name: switch2mac
projects.en: Mac app that turns your own Switch and Switch 2 dumps into native Apple Silicon apps, with a game-case library view. Not an emulator.
projects.zh: Mac 应用，把你自己 dump 的 Switch 和 Switch 2 游戏变成原生 Apple Silicon 应用，带游戏盒式的游戏库。不是模拟器。

projects.name: MetalNX
projects.en: One-click Switch-to-Mac port studio and graphics tweaker for M1 to M4 Macs, with a compatibility list.
projects.zh: 面向 M1 到 M4 Mac 的一键 Switch 转 Mac 移植工具和画面调节器，带兼容列表。

projects.name: kartnative
projects.game_zh: 马力欧卡丁车 世界（Switch 2）
projects.en: Fork of nxnative with Switch 2 graphics (NVN2) on Metal. Whole Grand Prix cups play on Apple Silicon Macs.
projects.zh: nxnative 的分支，把 Switch 2 图形（NVN2）转到 Metal。在 Apple Silicon Mac 上能完整跑完大奖赛杯赛。

projects.name: totk-mobile
projects.en: Experimental native port for Apple Silicon Macs and iPads, with an early iPhone build. Checks your files before building.
projects.zh: 实验性原生移植，支持 Apple Silicon Mac 和 iPad，iPhone 版处于早期。构建前会校验你的游戏文件。

projects.name: totk-ios
projects.en: Experimental native build for iPad and iPhone, made into a personal app from your own game files.
projects.zh: 实验性的 iPad 和 iPhone 原生版本，用你自己的游戏文件构建成个人应用。

projects.name: manosaba-ios
projects.game_en: Tears of the Kingdom, 魔法少女ノ魔女裁判
projects.game_zh: 王国之泪、魔法少女的魔女审判
projects.en: Tears of the Kingdom on iPhone and Mac, and 魔法少女ノ魔女裁判 on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Based on d2r-mobile.
projects.zh: 王国之泪跑在 iPhone 和 Mac 上，魔法少女的魔女审判跑在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上。基于 d2r-mobile。

projects.name: GreenKid-MV
projects.en: Game-free Mac builder for native Ocarina of Time (Switch 2) ports on Apple Silicon. Builds locally from your own dump.
projects.zh: 不含游戏的 Mac 构建器，在 Apple Silicon 上原生运行时之笛（Switch 2）。用你自己的 dump 在本机构建。

projects.name: ns2ios-shell
projects.en: Pack an iPhone IPA on Windows, no Mac needed, from your own NSP and prod.keys.
projects.zh: 在 Windows 上就能打包 iPhone 的 IPA，不需要 Mac，用你自己的 NSP 和 prod.keys。

projects.name: HookLink
projects.en: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2 Edition) on iPhone, built on your Mac from your own copy of the game.
projects.zh: 时之笛（Switch 2 版）跑在 iPhone 上，在你的 Mac 上用你自己的游戏构建。

projects.name: AC-Recomp
projects.en: Experimental static recompilation for macOS, with early Windows and Linux builds. Reaches the File 01 motorcycle chase.
projects.zh: 实验性静态重编译，主要面向 macOS，Windows 和 Linux 版处于早期。能玩到第一章的摩托追逐。

projects.name: nxnative-easy
projects.en: One-command nxnative setup: complete Mac apps, lightweight iPhone builds, Xbox and PlayStation controllers, editable touch controls.
projects.zh: 一条命令装好 nxnative：生成完整 Mac 应用和轻量 iPhone 版，支持 Xbox、PlayStation 手柄和可编辑触控。

projects.name: totk-pc-recomp
projects.en: Static recompilation to native Windows and Linux with a Vulkan renderer. Playable; visual bugs and crashes still expected.
projects.zh: 静态重编译为原生 Windows 和 Linux 程序，Vulkan 渲染。可以玩，但仍有画面问题和崩溃。

projects.name: Hookshot
projects.en: Native recompilation of the Switch 2 Ocarina of Time remake, with an in-game menu, frame generation and upscaling. Contains no game, keys or executable.
projects.zh: 时之笛 Switch 2 重制版的原生重编译，带游戏内菜单、插帧和超分。不含游戏、密钥或可执行文件。

projects.name: SavageWindRecomp
projects.en: Alpha static recompilation for Windows and Linux, made almost entirely with AI. No game files, keys or dumping tools included.
projects.zh: 面向 Windows 和 Linux 的静态重编译 Alpha 版，几乎全部由 AI 完成。不含游戏文件、密钥或 dump 工具。

projects.name: LASRecomp
projects.en: Beta static recompilation for Windows, Linux and macOS, made almost entirely with AI. Several other recomps here build on it.
projects.zh: 静态重编译 Beta 版，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，几乎全部由 AI 完成。这里好几个项目都基于它。

projects.name: ultratears
projects.en: Unofficial native PC and Steam Deck port that builds locally from your own extracted dump.
projects.zh: 非官方的原生 PC 和 Steam Deck 移植，用你自己解包的 dump 在本机构建。

projects.name: dkb-pc-recomp
projects.en: Static recompilation to native Windows with Vulkan. Plays through the first stage; still early and can crash.
projects.zh: 静态重编译为原生 Windows 程序，Vulkan 渲染。能玩完第一关，仍处于早期，会崩溃。

projects.name: B2recomp
projects.en: Unofficial static recompilation for Windows, built on your PC from your own dump. Beta.
projects.zh: 非官方静态重编译，Windows 版，用你自己的 dump 在电脑上构建。Beta 版。

projects.name: Recompia
projects.en: Native Windows build with Linux and handheld support, multiplayer, mods and keyboard and mouse.
projects.zh: 原生 Windows 版，也支持 Linux 和掌机，带联机、模组和键鼠操作。

projects.name: Weeping of the Empire
projects.en: Native Windows and Vulkan build with a frame cap up to 240, DLSS and mouse and keyboard. Mostly written by AI agents.
projects.zh: 原生 Windows 版，Vulkan 渲染，帧率上限可到 240，支持 DLSS 和键鼠。主要由 AI Agent 编写。

projects.name: Metroid-Dread-Recomp
projects.game_zh: 密特罗德 生存恐惧
projects.en: Static recompilation with a bundled compiler, a play and settings screen and an in-game menu. Current 0.x builds are early previews.
projects.zh: 静态重编译，自带编译器、启动和设置界面以及游戏内菜单。目前 0.x 版本是早期预览。

projects.name: OpenSmash Ultimate
projects.game_zh: 任天堂明星大乱斗 特别版
projects.en: The whole game as a native PC program: every mode, DLC fighters and stages, with an installer. Formerly ssbu-recomp.
projects.zh: 整个游戏变成原生 PC 程序：所有模式、DLC 角色和场景，带安装程序。原名 ssbu-recomp。

projects.name: xc2-recomp
projects.en: Static recompilation to native Windows with Vulkan. Boots to the title screen and runs New Game through the opening.
projects.zh: 静态重编译为原生 Windows 程序，Vulkan 渲染。能进标题画面，新游戏可以玩过开场。

projects.name: xcx-recomp
projects.game_zh: 异度神剑 X 终极版
projects.en: Static recompilation to native Windows with Vulkan. New Game, cutscenes and gameplay run.
projects.zh: 静态重编译为原生 Windows 程序，Vulkan 渲染。新游戏、过场和战斗都能跑。

projects.name: letsgo-recomp
projects.en: Native Windows port built on LAS Recomp. Work in progress: not yet played start to finish.
projects.zh: 基于 LAS Recomp 的原生 Windows 移植。仍在开发，还没有完整通关过。

projects.name: xc3-recomp
projects.en: Playable from New Game through the story, cutscenes and battles, with all four DLC packs.
projects.zh: 从新游戏开始可以玩主线、过场和战斗，支持全部四个 DLC。

projects.name: mkw-recomp
projects.game_zh: 马力欧卡丁车 世界（Switch 2）
projects.en: Static recompilation to a native PC program. Boots, plays the intro and races on Linux and Windows; some menus still need work.
projects.zh: 静态重编译为原生 PC 程序。在 Linux 和 Windows 上能启动、播开场、跑比赛，部分菜单还在修。

projects.name: totk-recomp
projects.en: Static recompilation to native Linux x86-64, aimed at the Steam Deck. Bring your own dump and keys.
projects.zh: 静态重编译为原生 Linux x86-64 程序，主要面向 Steam Deck。dump 和密钥自备。

projects.name: EoWRecomp
projects.en: Static recompilation to native PC, with an alpha Android app. Boots and plays the opening.
projects.zh: 静态重编译为原生 PC 程序，另有 Alpha 版 Android 应用。能启动并玩开场。

projects.name: MKW-THWOMP
projects.game_zh: 马力欧卡丁车 世界（Switch 2）
projects.en: Static recompilation to native Windows with Vulkan. Intro, title and menus render and races load; not fully playable yet.
projects.zh: 静态重编译为原生 Windows 程序，Vulkan 渲染。开场、标题和菜单能显示，比赛能载入，还不能完整游玩。

projects.name: totk-launcher
projects.en: Launcher for the TotK PC recomp: settings, key rebinding, keyboard prompts, achievements and save backups.
projects.zh: 王国之泪 PC recomp 的启动器：设置、改键、键鼠按键提示、成就和存档备份。

projects.name: mp4-recomp
projects.game_zh: 密特罗德 究极 4 穿越
projects.en: Static recompilation after a long stretch of play-testing: boots, plays, scans and sounds right, with an in-game menu.
projects.zh: 经过长时间试玩修复的静态重编译：能启动、游玩、扫描，声音正常，带游戏内菜单。

projects.name: smo-recomp
projects.game_zh: 超级马力欧 奥德赛
projects.en: Static recompilation to native Windows x64. Early, not finished.
projects.zh: 静态重编译为原生 Windows x64 程序。早期，尚未完成。

projects.name: KarPur
projects.en: Native Windows port built on LAS Recomp and TotK Recomp. Playable from the title screen into the open world with battles.
projects.zh: 基于 LAS Recomp 和 TotK Recomp 的原生 Windows 移植。从标题画面进入开放世界、对战都能玩。

projects.name: echora
projects.en: Experimental native recompilation of the Switch 2 Ocarina of Time.
projects.zh: 时之笛 Switch 2 版的实验性原生重编译。

projects.name: SuperWonders
projects.game_zh: 超级马力欧兄弟 惊奇
projects.en: Static recompilation for native PC, started from the DKB and TotK recomps, with an F1 in-game menu.
projects.zh: 原生 PC 静态重编译，从 DKB 和 TotK recomp 起步，带 F1 游戏内菜单。

projects.name: swsh-recomp
projects.en: Native Windows port built on Let's Go Recomp and LAS Recomp, tested with the Expansion Pass. Work in progress.
projects.zh: 基于 Let's Go Recomp 和 LAS Recomp 的原生 Windows 移植，已测试扩展票。仍在开发。

projects.name: oot-pc-recomp
projects.en: Static recompilation for PC. Not playable yet.
projects.zh: PC 静态重编译。还不能玩。

projects.name: metroid-prime-4-recomp
projects.game_zh: 密特罗德 究极 4 穿越
projects.en: Playable from the start: title screen, menus, saves and the opening cinematic. Targets the final Switch 1 update.
projects.zh: 从头就能玩：标题、菜单、存档和开场动画都正常。针对 Switch 1 的最终更新版本。

projects.name: KirbyRecomp
projects.game_zh: 超级星之卡比 大乱斗
projects.en: Experimental alpha static recompilation for Windows, built locally from your own ExeFS and RomFS.
projects.zh: 实验性 Alpha 版 Windows 静态重编译，用你自己的 ExeFS 和 RomFS 在本机构建。

projects.name: BOTWRecompAndroid
projects.en: Static recompilation for Android: playable from the title screen into the world, with saves and touch controls.
projects.zh: 面向 Android 的静态重编译：从标题画面进入世界都能玩，支持存档和触控。

projects.name: TOTKDroid
projects.en: Native Android build with touch controls, mods and a wide-screen option. Formerly TOTKRecompAndroid.
projects.zh: 原生 Android 版，支持触控、模组和宽屏。原名 TOTKRecompAndroid。

projects.name: totk-android
projects.en: Native Android port that draws menus, map and text at the screen's own resolution and backs up saves.
projects.zh: 原生 Android 移植，菜单、地图和文字按屏幕原生分辨率绘制，自动备份存档。

projects.name: DOOM Mobile
projects.en: The Switch release of DOOM running natively on ARM64 Android with Vulkan. The campaign is playable.
projects.zh: 毁灭战士 Switch 版原生跑在 ARM64 Android 上，Vulkan 渲染。战役可以玩。

projects.name: DroidPlay Core
projects.en: nxnative's Android port: Switch and Switch 2 games running natively on Android with Vulkan. Per-game results for handhelds and phones.
projects.zh: nxnative 的 Android 版：Switch 和 Switch 2 游戏原生跑在 Android 上，Vulkan 渲染。列出了各游戏在掌机和手机上的表现。

projects.name: diablo3-port
projects.en: The Switch release of Diablo III as a native ARM64 Android port with touch gestures. Derived from d2r-mobile.
projects.zh: 暗黑破坏神 III 的 Switch 版移植为原生 ARM64 Android 程序，支持触控手势。源自 d2r-mobile。

projects.name: dsr-native
projects.en: Static recompilation for Android. Very early, but mostly playable at a stable 60 fps.
projects.zh: 面向 Android 的静态重编译。非常早期，但大部分内容能以稳定 60 帧游玩。

projects.name: letsgo-recomp-android
projects.en: Android layer for letsgo-recomp. World, battles and saves work, but text is still invisible. README in Portuguese.
projects.zh: letsgo-recomp 的 Android 版。世界、战斗和存档能用，但文字还显示不出来。README 是葡萄牙语。

projects.name: totkonandroid
projects.en: Experimental ARM64 Android runtime, with the AYN Thor handheld as the reference device. Source only.
projects.zh: 实验性 ARM64 Android 运行时，以 AYN Thor 掌机为参考设备。只有源码。

projects.name: SwitchRECOMP
projects.en: Static recompiler for Switch games: translates the ARM64 code to C once and builds a native Windows or Linux program. No games, keys or firmware included.
projects.zh: Switch 游戏的静态重编译器：把 ARM64 代码一次性翻译成 C，再编译成原生 Windows 或 Linux 程序。不含游戏、密钥或固件。

projects.name: kirikae
projects.en: Static recompiler in Rust that turns Switch executables into native PC programs. Early preview, already runs complete 3D games.
projects.zh: 用 Rust 写的静态重编译器，把 Switch 可执行文件变成原生 PC 程序。早期预览，已经能跑完整的 3D 游戏。

projects.name: Switch2RECOMP
projects.en: Static recompiler for Switch and Switch 2 games, for Windows and Linux with OpenGL and Vulkan.
projects.zh: Switch 和 Switch 2 游戏的静态重编译器，支持 Windows 和 Linux，OpenGL 和 Vulkan。

projects.name: nxrecomp
projects.game_zh: 密特罗德 究极 复刻版
projects.en: Shared recompiler, runtime and tools for running Switch games natively on Windows, with Metroid Prime Remastered as the first target.
projects.zh: 让 Switch 游戏原生跑在 Windows 上的通用重编译器、运行时和工具，第一个目标是密特罗德 究极 复刻版。

projects.name: SwitchWakerHD
projects.en: Wind Waker HD (Wii U) on a Switch, deko3d renderer.
projects.zh: 风之杖 HD（Wii U）跑在 Switch 上，deko3d 渲染。

projects.zh: 极品飞车 9 最高通缉（Xbox 360）跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: mcdub3-nx
projects.en: Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition on a Switch, plus Linux, Mac, Android and Windows.
projects.zh: 午夜俱乐部 3 跑在 Switch 上，也有 Linux、Mac、Android 和 Windows 版。

projects.name: SwitchWaker
projects.en: The Wind Waker (GameCube) on a Switch.
projects.zh: 风之杖（GameCube）跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: sh2-nx
projects.en: Silent Hill 2 (PC) on a Switch.
projects.zh: 寂静岭 2（PC）跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: mgr-nx-deko
projects.en: Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance (Xbox 360) on a Switch.
projects.zh: 合金装备崛起：复仇（Xbox 360）跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: sh3-nx
projects.en: Silent Hill 3 (PC) on a Switch.
projects.zh: 寂静岭 3（PC）跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: prototype-switch
projects.en: Prototype and Prototype 2 (Xbox 360) on a Switch.
projects.zh: 虐杀原形 1 和 2（Xbox 360）跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: conker-lr-recomp
projects.en: Conker: Live & Reloaded (Xbox) on a Switch, Linux and Windows.
projects.zh: 松鼠康克（Xbox）跑在 Switch、Linux 和 Windows 上。

projects.name: mk9-nx
projects.en: Mortal Kombat Komplete Edition (Xbox 360) on a Switch.
projects.zh: 真人快打 9 完全版（Xbox 360）跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: gears2-nx
projects.en: Gears of War 2 (Xbox 360) on a Switch.
projects.zh: 战争机器 2（Xbox 360）跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: Lazarus
projects.en: Mass Effect 2 (Xbox 360) on a Switch.
projects.zh: 质量效应 2（Xbox 360）跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: bo2-360-nx
projects.en: Black Ops II (Xbox 360) on a Switch and Windows.
projects.zh: 使命召唤 黑色行动 II（Xbox 360）跑在 Switch 和 Windows 上。

projects.name: sa2-nx
projects.en: Sonic Adventure 2 (Xbox Live Arcade) on a Switch at 60 fps.
projects.zh: 索尼克大冒险 2（XBLA）以 60 帧跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: usf4-nx
projects.en: Ultra Street Fighter IV (Xbox 360) on a Switch and PC.
projects.zh: 终极街头霸王 IV（Xbox 360）跑在 Switch 和 PC 上。

projects.name: the-simpsons-game-nx
projects.en: The Simpsons Game (Xbox 360) on a Switch.
projects.zh: 辛普森一家（Xbox 360）跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: NFS-Carbon-NX
projects.en: Need for Speed Carbon (Xbox 360) on a Switch.
projects.zh: 极品飞车 10 卡本峡谷（Xbox 360）跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: lm-nx
projects.en: Luigi's Mansion (GameCube) on a Switch.
projects.zh: 路易吉洋馆（GameCube）跑在 Switch 上。

projects.name: awesome-decomp-games
projects.en: Decompilations and recompilations for every console, in one big table.
projects.zh: 覆盖所有主机的反编译和重编译大表。

projects.en: Game decompilation projects.
